newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Costello sees effects of rate cuts in 1997.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Costello sees effects of rate cuts in 1997.

text.p: Australian Treasurer Peter Costello said on Thursday the effect of interest rate cuts in July and November would kick in in 1997.

"If you cut official interest rates they (the effects) kick in ... they kick in subsequent to the cuts ... they will kick in in 1997," Costello told parliament. The treasurer also said the housing sector would recover from excess supply next year.
"We expect the supply and demand to be coming back more into equivalence in 1997 and we expect a pick-up in 1997," he said.
